name: KNOWN BUG: Expected HTTP 401 rejection due to token confusion (using refreshToken as accessToken)
description: Technique: Security Testing / Token Confusion (OWASP API2). Validates that a refreshToken cannot be used to consume resource endpoints (/auth/me). DummyJSON fails by accepting both tokens interchangeably.
descriptionHtml: Technique: Security Testing / Token Confusion (OWASP API2). Validates that a refreshToken cannot be used to consume resource endpoints (/auth/me). DummyJSON fails by accepting both tokens interchangeably.
